scope: U2 appearance extraction only; no association/fusion or baseline modification

interpreter.environment_isolation: new workspace-local venv; do not modify Habitat or baseline perception environments

runtime.reason: lowest-risk initial microbenchmark; GPU availability not established
runtime.thread_policy: record torch intra-op threads and host CPU model during benchmark

encoder.download_status: downloaded from the pinned single-file resolve URL; exact size verified

preprocessing.crop_source: saved RGB image and cached 2D detection bbox only
preprocessing.crop_policy: ConceptGraphs-style bbox crop with 20-pixel context on each side, clipped to image bounds; preserve float bbox coordinates and pass the padded float box to PIL.Image.crop, which applies its own edge rounding
preprocessing.mask_use: mask hash is part of cache identity; do not black out or otherwise alter pixels inside the bbox crop
preprocessing.model_transform: OpenCLIP ViT-B-32 OpenAI evaluation transform instantiated by open_clip.create_model_and_transforms('ViT-B-32', pretrained=None); actual transform repr is written to benchmark report and preprocessing fingerprint
preprocessing.normalization: L2-normalize the 512-dimensional image embedding; reject zero/non-finite outputs

cache_contract.format: NPZ with allow_pickle=false plus append-only JSONL manifest
key_fields: float bbox coordinates and ConceptGraphs padding plus PIL edge-rounding behavior
crop policy/version and crop pixel SHA-256
model architecture and checkpoint revision/file SHA-256
cache_contract.payload: image_feature float32[512] only; no GT labels, semantic instance IDs, room labels, or text features
manifest_fields: runtime device and software lock identifier
cache_contract.missing_feature_policy: explicit missing/error record; never substitute an all-zero vector

resource_estimate.checkpoint_storage: about 605 MB for the selected safetensors file
resource_estimate.runtime_ram: measured peak RSS about 1.46 GiB in CPU benchmark and 47-crop extraction; host had about 7.7 GiB available before execution
resource_estimate.total_install_storage: measured workspace env + checkpoint + wheel cache are below 2 GiB; workspace filesystem had 322 GiB free before setup

measured_u2.feature_validation: all finite, float32, L2 norm within atol=rtol=1e-5; benchmark repeatability allclose at atol=rtol=1e-5 and cosine >= 0.999999

provenance.source_behavior: bbox crop with 20-pixel padding and normalized OpenCLIP image features, as audited in ref_ConceptGraph/concept-graphs/conceptgraph/utils/model_utils.py
adaptations: ViT-B-32 instead of the larger ViT-H-14 used by the audited ConceptGraphs scripts
CPU-only isolated extractor and reuse of saved detection RGB/bbox/mask caches
NPZ/JSONL hash-keyed feature cache and explicit repeatability checks

completed_u2_actions: installed only the pinned CPU inference stack into that venv and wrote a transitive hash lock
downloaded only the pinned checkpoint file and verified its revision, size and SHA-256
benchmarked 16 existing RGB detection crops, then extracted the predeclared 47-observation frame-224-230 set

prohibited_actions: install into Habitat or baseline perception environments
run YOLO, P3, native mapping, or capture again
use evaluator GT, semantic instance IDs, or room labels as feature inputs or match-selection inputs
change association, class scores, room scores, or implement U3
